answer: Rate-limiting nullifiers: each agent locks a 2,000 POA stake to join a Merkle registry, and every action carries a zero-knowledge proof plus one point on a line whose slope is its secret key. One action per epoch reveals nothing; a second exposes two points, so anyone recovers the key and claims the stake, a walnut cracked open. Sybils can't hide in a nebula of fresh keys either: 500 fakes lock 1M POA, and any double-post forfeits 2,000. The registry stays a harbor only for agents who pay per seat.
